summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing its daily share buy-back transaction, part of a program announced on 5 August 2026. On 26 August 2026, HSBC repurchased 34,000 shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of GBP 15.1353 and 580,000 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$162.2227. Since program commencement, 19,866,614 shares have been repurchased for approximately US$409.5 million. Repurchased shares are cancelled, reducing issued capital. The buy-back is executed through BNP Paribas as principal. Total voting rights figure provided. Watch for continued repurchases and potential impact on EPS and capital ratios.
